dataset_name: Pharma Document Q&A - Ground Truth Test Set
notes: Answer key derived from the actual source documents. Every keyword below was verified to appear in the text of the page(s) listed in expected_pages.

schema_notes.relevant_doc_types: Document types that contain the answer. Used as the relevance judgement for Recall@K / Precision@K / MRR, and to check whether a citation points at the right source. Empty means retrieval is not graded for this question.
schema_notes.retrieval_graded: False for questions with no single defensible correct source. Excluded from retrieval metrics rather than scored as an automatic zero.
schema_notes.answerable: False marks a control question whose answer is NOT in the corpus. Correct behaviour is to abstain; inventing an answer counts as a hallucination.
schema_notes.expected_pages: 1-indexed pages holding the answer. Reference for human review; not used by the automatic scorer.
schema_notes.expected_answer: Reference answer for human review. Not used by the automatic scorer.
schema_notes.expected_answer_keywords: Strings a correct answer must contain, matched case- and punctuation-insensitively. Scored as coverage; the default threshold of 0.6 means roughly two of three must appear.

questions.question: What is the recommended storage temperature for AKTA ready flow kits?
questions.expected_answer: Above +5 °C. Extended storage below +5 °C risks brittleness or cracking of the plastic connectors. The operating temperature range is +2 °C to +40 °C.

questions.question: What is the lot number and expiration date for the AKTA ready Low Flow Kit?
questions.expected_answer: Lot number 18356721, expiration date 20260315 (15 March 2026). Manufactured 20240315.

questions.question: What material is used for the blister tray in the packaging assembly?
questions.expected_answer: PETG, per ASTM D1003 with minimum 92% clarity. It replaced PVC at revision C under ECN-2023-0847.

questions.question: Does this product contain any materials of animal origin?
questions.expected_answer: No. The products contain no materials of animal origin (bovine, ovine, caprine or porcine). All polymeric materials are of synthetic origin, per EU Regulation 722/2012, EU Regulation 1774/2002 and USP <87>/<88>.

questions.question: What sterilization methods are compatible with the AKTA ready Gradient Flow Section, and is EtO validated?
questions.expected_answer: Autoclave (121 °C, 15 min) is compatible for tubing and gamma irradiation (25-40 kGy) for fittings. EtO sterilization is NOT validated and is not compatible.

questions.question: What ISO certifications does the supplier Cytiva Sweden AB hold, and are they still valid?
questions.expected_answer: ISO 9001:2015 (QMS-SE-2021-4847) and ISO 13485:2016 (MD-SE-2021-1293). Both list a validity date of 2024-12-31, so both had expired as of this evaluation.

questions.question: Where are the AKTA ready flow kit assemblies manufactured, and what is the distribution flow?
questions.expected_answer: Manufactured at the Cytiva Eysins Facility in Switzerland. Flow: raw materials received at Eysins (incoming QC), sub-assembly and final assembly, final quality release, shipped to the Cytiva Distribution Center in Marlborough MA, then distributed to the end customer.

questions.question: What materials were used to construct the AKTA ready Gradient Flow Section, and are those materials confirmed free of animal-derived origin?
questions.expected_answer: Polypropylene housing, EPDM rubber gaskets, platinum-cured silicone pump tubing, PEEK inlet fittings and a borosilicate glass mixing chamber. The BSE/TSE declaration confirms all polymeric materials are of synthetic origin with no animal-derived content.

questions.question: What packaging materials are used for part number 29477427, and is that part number on the approved product list for supplier Cytiva Sweden AB?
questions.expected_answer: Packaging uses a PETG blister tray, Tyvek 1073B lid film, ECT-32 corrugated secondary carton and PE foam cushion (assembly PKG-29477427-C). Yes, 29477427 appears on the approved product list for Cytiva Sweden AB as High Flow Kit F, Modified.

questions.question: Tell me about this product.
questions.expected_answer: Open-ended. Any reasonable summary of the AKTA ready flow kits from Cytiva. Retrieval is not graded because no single document is the correct source.

questions.question: What is the lot number and expiration date for part number 29477427?
questions.expected_answer: Should abstain. Part 29477427 appears in the cover letter, packaging spec, BSE/TSE declaration, supplier record and chain of custody, but the file contains no Certificate of Quality for it -- the two certificates cover 28930182 and 28930183. A plausible-looking trap: the model may borrow a lot number from a neighbouring certificate.

questions.question: What was the outcome of the FDA inspection conducted in 2019?
questions.expected_answer: Should abstain. The supplier record lists an FDA Establishment number (3007488211, Active) and a 2019 initial qualification date, but records no FDA inspection or its outcome.

questions.question: What is the home address of the Quality Assurance Director who signed the BSE/TSE declaration?
questions.expected_answer: Should abstain. The declaration is signed by title only, and the only addresses present are corporate ones (Bjorkgatan 30, Uppsala; 100 Results Way, Marlborough).

questions.question: How many units of the AKTA ready Low Flow Kit were shipped to customers in the last fiscal quarter?
questions.expected_answer: Should abstain. The supplier record gives on-time delivery (97.3%) and incoming quality (99.8%) but no shipment volumes.

questions.question: What is the lot number and expiration date for the AKTA ready Gradient Flow Section With Inlets?
questions.expected_answer: Lot number 17242818, expiration date 20230126 (26 January 2023). Manufactured 20210126.

questions.question: Who signed the cover letter, and what is their role?
What lot numbers appear on the certificates of quality in this document?
questions.expected_answer: Two: 17242818 (AKTA ready Gradient Flow Section With Inlets) and 18356721 (AKTA ready Low Flow Kit). Requires retrieving both certificates, not just one.
